_comment: UserPromptSubmit hook: nudges graphify-first, but only in projects that actually have a graphify-out/ graph. Merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by scripts/merge_settings.py. Identified for removal by the 'graphify-out' marker in the command.

hooks.command: [ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/graphify-out" ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"This project uses graphify (knowledge graph in graphify-out/). For any question about the codebase, its architecture, files, or content, invoke the graphify skill FIRST (Skill tool, skill graphify) before other tools, treating the prompt as a graphify query."}}' || exit 0
